```{r} 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

source("feature_engineering_functions.R")
training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

poisson_formula <- Goals ~ DSTF + TeamRankCategory + HomeAway + opp_defence_score + 
    attack_score + DCS + DSF + DYF + OpponentRankCategory + DLF

beta_grid <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.01)


# Build a function which converts predicted goals into match outcomes and then calculates the predicted and actual league tables
season_table <- function(df, beta) {
  mp <- df %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway,
                values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)) %>%
    mutate(
      gd       = predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away,
      pred_res = case_when(abs(gd) <= beta ~ "D", gd > beta ~ "H", TRUE ~ "A"),
      act_res  = case_when(Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
                           Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A", TRUE ~ "D")
    )

  pts <- function(res, side) case_when(res == side ~ 3, res == "D" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)

  tab <- bind_rows(
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Home,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "H"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "H"),
                     pred_gd = gd, act_gd = Goals_Home - Goals_Away,
                     act_gf = Goals_Home),
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Away,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "A"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "A"),
                     pred_gd = -gd, act_gd = Goals_Away - Goals_Home,
                     act_gf = Goals_Away)
  ) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pred_pts), desc(pred_gd), Team) %>%        
    mutate(pred_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(desc(act_pts), desc(act_gd), desc(act_gf), Team) %>%  
    mutate(act_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(Team)

  list(tab = tab, mp = mp)
}


beta_cv <- function(training_data, poisson_formula, beta_grid, min_train = 1) {

  seasons <- training_data %>%
    distinct(Year) %>%
    mutate(s = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
    arrange(s) %>%
    pull(Year)

  map_dfr((min_train + 1):length(seasons), function(i) {

    train_fold <- training_data %>%
      filter(Year %in% seasons[1:(i - 1)])

    valid_fold <- training_data %>%
      filter(Year == seasons[i])

    # Fit Poisson model using previous seasons
    m <- glm(
      poisson_formula,
      data = train_fold,
      family = stats::poisson(link = "log")
    )

    # Predict goals in validation season
    valid_fold <- valid_fold %>%
      mutate(
        predicted_goals = predict(
          m,
          newdata = valid_fold,
          type = "response"
        )
      )

    # Evaluate each beta
    map_dfr(beta_grid, function(b) {

      st <- season_table(valid_fold, b)

      tibble(
        Season = seasons[i],
        Beta = b,
        rank_mse = mean(
          (st$tab$pred_rank - st$tab$act_rank)^2
        ),
        spearman = cor(
          st$tab$pred_rank,
          st$tab$act_rank,
          method = "spearman"
        )
      )
    })
  })
}

beta_results <- beta_cv(training_data, poisson_formula, beta_grid)

beta_chosen_by_season <- beta_results %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  slice_min(rank_mse, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

beta_chosen_by_season %>%
  summarise(
    mean_beta = mean(Beta),
    sd_beta = sd(Beta),
    min_beta = min(Beta),
    max_beta = max(Beta),
    mean_rank_mse = mean(rank_mse),
    mean_spearman = mean(spearman)
  )

beta_chosen_by_season %>%
  select(Season, Beta, rank_mse, spearman)

beta_results %>%
  group_by(Beta) %>%
  summarise(mean_rank_mse = mean(rank_mse), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(Beta, mean_rank_mse)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(beta_chosen_by_season$Beta), colour = "red") +
  labs(y = "Mean squared rank error")
```
From the first table, I will take the value of beta to be 0.473.
